# Daily Briefing – 11 September 2026

Yesterday was a lighter day with no structured training, 8,518 steps, and 2,401 calories burned — basically maintenance. The real concern is that 5.3 hours of sleep, which is simply too short for proper recovery and adaptation.

Your HRV at 98ms sits just below your baseline of 99–118ms, which combined with the poor sleep is your body quietly waving a yellow flag. Nothing alarming — your resting HR of 50bpm and stress score of 31 both look great — but don't push hard intensity today. Keep it aerobic and controlled.

Tonight, prioritise sleep above everything. Aim for 8 hours minimum — it's genuinely your biggest performance lever right now. On nutrition, hit your 175g protein today regardless; poor sleep increases muscle breakdown, so protein becomes even more critical. You're 118 days out — protecting recovery *is* the training.
